blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Makati City Regional Trial Court has ordered the arrest of Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste for allegedly violating the Public Service Act. The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) confirmed the arrest warrant to reporters on Wednesday morning and provided a copy of the document. READ: Only P80M recovered so far
